  "title": "Changes to product description aren't logged in invoice history",
  "body": "When changing the price of a product and saving the invoice this action gets added to the history of the invoice, alright.\r\n\r\nIf you change the description of a product in the invoice, though, this is not represented in the history.\r\n\r\nI guess this is related due to a change that happens to the product and not the invoice itself in the backend but maybe this is something that should be added to the history of an invoice if a product description is changed, for all invoices affected.",
  "author": "Participant 1",
  "created_at": "2016-12-23T16:27:23Z",
  "updated_at": "2017-01-01T18:12:17Z",

    {
      "id": 269315654,
      "url": "https://github.com/invoiceninja/invoiceninja/issues/1219#issuecomment-269315654",
      "created_at": "2016-12-27T11:47:56Z",
      "updated_at": null,
      "author": "Participant 2",
      "body": "I'm not sure I follow this. If i make a change to the product description, this is reflected accurately in the invoice history.\r\n\r\nProduct data in existing invoices are NOT updated by design. For example, if a product cost changes at a later date, this should not affect existing invoices. The product description is a point in time representation of a product."
    },
    {
      "id": 269315767,
      "url": "https://github.com/invoiceninja/invoiceninja/issues/1219#issuecomment-269315767",
      "created_at": "2016-12-27T11:49:12Z",
      "updated_at": "2016-12-27T11:52:25Z",
      "author": "Participant 1",
      "body": "If I change the product description within an invoice (not from products -> edit a product, but invoices -> edit an invoice) I get no history update of the invoice. If I change the product cost I get a history update, though.\r\n\r\nEDIT: Just for clarification: I edit the product description and the description in the invoice _**is changed**_. There's just no notification about this in the invoice history at all. You say that product data in existing invoices is not updated, but it is."
    },
    {
      "id": 269317767,
      "url": "https://github.com/invoiceninja/invoiceninja/issues/1219#issuecomment-269317767",
      "created_at": "2016-12-27T12:09:29Z",
      "updated_at": "2016-12-27T12:12:15Z",
      "author": "Participant 1",
      "body": "How to replicate:\r\n\r\n1. Create a simple invoice and save it.\r\n![image](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/6761196/21499324/2124dee2-cc35-11e6-9b84-88ecbd686345.png)\r\n\r\n2. Now change the cost\r\n![image](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/6761196/21499343/49769f3e-cc35-11e6-8571-bdfc3febd29f.png)\r\n\r\n3. You see a second history version in the invoice history now\r\n![image](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/6761196/21499360/654882e0-cc35-11e6-9050-35a7ba68fbdd.png)\r\n\r\n4. Now change only the product description and save the invoice\r\n![image](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/6761196/21499371/80d5b2ee-cc35-11e6-9bfd-0a33a8d7e3e3.png)\r\n\r\n5. You still see only two versions of the history\r\n![image](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/6761196/21499386/9a54e118-cc35-11e6-9c41-c0c424886aa0.png)\r\n\r\n6. But the product description changed in the invoice and also in the client portal!\r\n![image](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/6761196/21499391/a7cbec56-cc35-11e6-85ca-b0b6e3f756bd.png)\r\n\r\n@turbo124 Did I convey the problem properly now? There is no new third history entry. The second history entry shows the different cost and product description simultaneously but the activity stream only mentions a product price change. A product description change isn't mentioned anywhere. The customer can't see this without explicitly looking at older versions of the invoice. (And this also only works if something was changed that activated a history entry. **Changing the product description only doesn't generate a new history entry; you can change the product description without a way for the customer to notice it at all.**"
    },
    {
      "id": 269764169,
      "url": "https://github.com/invoiceninja/invoiceninja/issues/1219#issuecomment-269764169",
      "created_at": "2016-12-30T12:03:01Z",
      "updated_at": null,
      "author": "Participant 2",
      "body": "@Braintelligence I have failed to replicate this issue.\r\n\r\nInvoice history works perfectly for me. I am wondering if there is an issue with your browser type."
    },
    {
      "id": 269898953,
      "url": "https://github.com/invoiceninja/invoiceninja/issues/1219#issuecomment-269898953",
      "created_at": "2017-01-01T11:03:42Z",
      "updated_at": null,
      "author": "Participant 3",
      "body": "I'm able to replicate this problem. Note: it only occurs if you just change the product texts."
    },
    {
      "id": 269910105,

      "updated_at": null,
      "author": "Participant 1",
      "body": "Well I even provided a screenshot of how I only changed the product text and nothing else (I thought it's called description).\r\nI don't know how it could have worked for @turbo124 if he followed my reproducing steps."
    }
